{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure we have the latest
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, removing currency symbols and commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for 'loyal' segment (lowercase)
loyal_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check for 'completed' order status
completed_orders = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate mean revenue for completed orders from loyal customers
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue"}
